title: Three Marks mod session report sharing (opt-in)
description: The opt-in session report to the player's own Telegram / Discord linked on the site (config share_session_report, off by default; nothing is sent before the player turns it on). POST /mod/me/session-share body #/definitions/preference -> 200 #/definitions/preferenceAnswer stores the server flag: while it is on, the server posts the session card to the chosen channels when the mod's live session ends (the session_idle_minutes gap). POST /mod/me/session-share/send body #/definitions/sendRequest -> 202 #/definitions/sendAnswer posts the card of that session now (the window button). Signed exactly like /mod/ingest (v2: X-Otmetki-Device, X-Otmetki-Timestamp, X-Otmetki-Nonce, X-Otmetki-Signature over the raw body) and answered only for the device's bound account: a body naming another account is refused with 403 account_mismatch; 429 with Retry-After when rate-limited; every error reply carries X-Otmetki-Server-Time. 409 #/definitions/error channel_not_linked when a chosen channel is not linked on the site; 404 #/definitions/error session_not_found from /send when the server has no mod session with battles under that session_id (nothing ingested yet, or already purged): the mod shows a short notice and sends nothing else. The report is built on the server from the account's own battles only; the mod sends no battle data here.
